name: Machine Learning
boundaries: Machine Learning: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete mathematical theory of generalization and scaling
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by MLC-01. Exact laws for every architecture, and safe scaling beyond present models, are not additional concepts. Certificates for a finished model remain MLC-10.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scalable continual learning without catastrophic forgetting, with 100 percent retention
original_dispositions.reason: The 100 percent figure is not adopted. Loss of plasticity stays inside MLC-03 because the first-pass entry already treats it as a distinct failure that the same breakthrough has to close.

original_dispositions.original_title: Human-level sample efficiency, including one to ten examples
original_dispositions.reason: The entry remains apprenticeship-scale acquisition when the relevant structure is absent from pretraining. In-context few-shot reuse is an achieved component and was not given a new ID.

original_dispositions.original_title: Full mechanistic interpretability, including pseudocode for every decision
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by MLC-06. Safety certification of an envelope is MLC-10, not a second interpretability concept.

original_dispositions.original_title: A new learning rule that surpasses backpropagation, with lower energy and consumer-hardware training
original_dispositions.reason: Matching backpropagation without a global backward pass is MLC-05. Biological-order measured power is MLC-11. A requirement to beat backpropagation’s accuracy on GPUs was not added.

original_dispositions.original_title: Built-in causal reasoning and counterfactual simulation
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by MLC-04. Automated scientific discovery is MLC-08.

original_dispositions.original_title: Brain-comparable energy efficiency, stated as 10^15 operations per second at about 20 watts
original_dispositions.reason: The 10^15 figure is Carlsmith’s uncertain sufficiency estimate for FLOP/s given the right software. It is not a measured brain rate and is not the completion test.

original_dispositions.original_title: Provable alignment and safety for arbitrarily capable systems under all inputs and self-modifications
original_dispositions.reason: The checkable subset is MLC-10. The remainder depends on an unformalized account of human values and on further breakthroughs about self-modification. Ngo, Chan, and Mindermann frame goal conflict but do not define a completed learning principle at this bar.
The entries were not merged. Verifier-backed algorithm search, including AlphaEvolve, stays on the achieved side of both.

original_dispositions.original_title: A unified cognitive architecture for AGI, and an intelligence explosion
original_dispositions.reason: It restates the other entries as one system and then adds downstream social and strategic consequences. Those consequences require further breakthroughs that this item does not specify.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Initial note, 2026-11-01: selection dropped abstract-puzzle solving after ARC Prize’s 2026 results, and kept verifier-backed algorithm search on the achieved side of MLC-07 and MLC-08.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Puzzle scores and verifier-backed algorithm search are achieved components, not the missing discoveries.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Revision, same cutoff: every first-pass identity is retained, and MLC-11 is added.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The revised list keeps MLC-01 through MLC-10 and adds MLC-11.

reconciliation_change_log.change: MLC-01 now records double descent and neural scaling laws as phenomena a predictive theory must explain, and the Acta Numerica DOI is confirmed from the Cambridge abstract page.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Fitting those phenomena after the runs does not supply the missing forecast.

reconciliation_change_log.change: MLC-02 states why a one-to-ten-example bar was not adopted, and points the power budget to MLC-11.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The entry stays apprenticeship-scale acquisition when relevant structure was absent from pretraining; brain-comparable power is a separate requirement.

reconciliation_change_log.change: MLC-03 states that 100 percent retention was not sourced and is not the completion test.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The proposal uses a pre-registered drop and requires both retention and continued plasticity.

reconciliation_change_log.change: MLC-04, MLC-06, MLC-07, and MLC-08 flag overlaps with the historical wording without merging entries.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The entries preserve distinct capabilities and completion tests.

reconciliation_change_log.change: MLC-05 is narrowed to the local rule. Its earlier energy discussion is now the separate entry MLC-11.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A biological-order power budget is a radical change in cost and accessibility and is not implied by a local rule on a GPU.

reconciliation_change_log.change: AlphaEvolve’s author list is taken from the arXiv abstract page opened this turn.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The result is verifier-backed algorithm discovery and marks the boundary of both candidates.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The historical list’s workshop, survey, Nature, DeepMind, and JMLR citations were checked and are not used as evidence.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The supporting citations could not be verified.
